spans.s: शे case-ending seen in Vedic Litera- ture substituted for any one of the 2l case-endings as found in Vedic Language; words ending in this शे ( ए ) are not coalesced with a vowel that follows; e.g अस्मे इन्द्र- बृहस्पती; cf.
से (1) one of the several affixes found in Veda in the sense ofतुमुन् ( तुम् of the infinitive); e. g. वृक्षे राय:; cf. Pan.
; (2) personal-ending substituted for थास् in the pres., perfect, and other tenses; cf. थासः से
